primaryGoal: Identify the top 3 worst performing RevOps Hierarchy units (highest M0 to M1 drop) for the current month, and within each, identify the campaigns with the highest drop to pinpoint underperforming marketing initiatives.
assumptions: The current month refers to the month in which the analysis is being executed, and both [Opportunity M0 Date] and [Opportunity M1 Date] fall within this month.

A 'drop' from M0 to M1 is calculated as the absolute difference ([f Opportunity M0 Created Count] - [f Opportunity M1 Created Count]), where a higher positive value indicates worse performance (more opportunities lost in the transition).
All opportunities with [Opportunity Source] = 'marketing' and [Opportunity Source MQL Classification] in ('digital', 'events') are relevant for this analysis.
The [RevOps Hierarchy] and [Opportunity MQL Touch Last Campaign Name] fields are populated and accurate for all relevant opportunities.
We will fetch all data in a single comprehensive pull to enable complete analysis without additional data retrieval, as specified in the user context.

phases.phaseTitle: Comprehensive Data Retrieval for RevOps and Campaign Performance Analysis
phases.phaseDescription: Fetch all necessary data at the most granular level (RevOps Hierarchy and Campaign Name) for the current month with all required filters applied. This single fetch will provide the foundation for identifying the top 3 worst performing RevOps hierarchies and their associated underperforming campaigns.

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 1: Complete RevOps Hierarchy and Campaign Performance Data for Current Month
fetchSteps.objective: Retrieve all M0 and M1 opportunity counts grouped by RevOps Hierarchy and Campaign Name for marketing-sourced opportunities (digital and events) in the current month to enable both hierarchy-level and campaign-level analysis.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Columns: [RevOps Hierarchy], [Opportunity MQL Touch Last Campaign Name], [f Opportunity M0 Created Count], [f Opportunity M1 Created Count]. Filters: [Opportunity Source] = 'marketing', [Opportunity Source MQL Classification] in ('digital', 'events'), [Opportunity M0 Date] is in current month, [Opportunity M1 Date] is in current month. Aggregation: SUM of [f Opportunity M0 Created Count] and SUM of [f Opportunity M1 Created Count] grouped by [RevOps Hierarchy] and [Opportunity MQL Touch Last Campaign Name].
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: Fetch all opportunities where [Opportunity Source] is 'marketing' and [Opportunity Source MQL Classification] is in 'digital' and 'events' and [Opportunity M0 Date] is in the current month and [Opportunity M1 Date] is in the current month. Include columns [RevOps Hierarchy], [Opportunity MQL Touch Last Campaign Name], and the sum of [f Opportunity M0 Created Count] and the sum of [f Opportunity M1 Created Count] grouped by [RevOps Hierarchy] and [Opportunity MQL Touch Last Campaign Name].
fetchSteps.phaseTitle: Comprehensive Data Retrieval for RevOps and Campaign Performance Analysis

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 1: Calculate M0 to M1 Drop by RevOps Hierarchy
analysisSteps.aggregation: SUM of [f Opportunity M0 Created Count] and SUM of [f Opportunity M1 Created Count] across all campaigns within each RevOps Hierarchy
analysisSteps.question: Which RevOps Hierarchy units experienced the highest absolute drop from M0 to M1 opportunities in the current month?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Using the fetched data, aggregate the [f Opportunity M0 Created Count] and [f Opportunity M1 Created Count] by [RevOps Hierarchy] (summing across all [Opportunity MQL Touch Last Campaign Name] values within each hierarchy). For each [RevOps Hierarchy], calculate the M0 to M1 Drop as ([f Opportunity M0 Created Count] - [f Opportunity M1 Created Count]). Rank all RevOps Hierarchy units by this drop value in descending order (highest drop first). Identify and list the top 3 RevOps Hierarchy units with the highest drop. Present the results in a table with columns: [RevOps Hierarchy], Total M0 Count, Total M1 Count, M0 to M1 Drop, and Rank. Provide a brief insight on which hierarchies are underperforming the most.
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Comprehensive Data Retrieval for RevOps and Campaign Performance Analysis

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 2: Identify Worst Performing Campaigns Within Top 3 RevOps Hierarchies
analysisSteps.groupBy: [RevOps Hierarchy] and [Opportunity MQL Touch Last Campaign Name]
analysisSteps.aggregation: Direct use of [f Opportunity M0 Created Count] and [f Opportunity M1 Created Count] at the campaign level
analysisSteps.question: For each of the top 3 worst performing RevOps Hierarchy units, which campaign ([Opportunity MQL Touch Last Campaign Name]) had the highest absolute drop from M0 to M1?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Using the fetched data and the top 3 RevOps Hierarchy units identified in Analysis 1.1.1, filter the dataset to include only rows where [RevOps Hierarchy] matches one of the top 3. For each of these RevOps Hierarchy units, calculate the M0 to M1 Drop for each [Opportunity MQL Touch Last Campaign Name] as ([f Opportunity M0 Created Count] - [f Opportunity M1 Created Count]). Within each of the top 3 RevOps Hierarchy units, rank the campaigns by their drop value in descending order and identify the campaign with the highest drop. Present the results in a table with columns: [RevOps Hierarchy], [Opportunity MQL Touch Last Campaign Name], M0 Count, M1 Count, M0 to M1 Drop. Provide insights on which specific campaigns are contributing most to the poor performance of each hierarchy unit and recommend further investigation or corrective actions.
analysisSteps.phaseTitle: Comprehensive Data Retrieval for RevOps and Campaign Performance Analysis

phases.phaseDescription: Synthesize findings from Phase 1 to provide a clear narrative on the worst performing RevOps hierarchies and campaigns, and deliver actionable recommendations for improvement.

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 2: No Additional Fetch Required (Use Phase 1 Results)
fetchSteps.objective: Synthesize and summarize insights from Phase 1 analyses without additional data retrieval.
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: No fetch required. Use the results from Phase 1 analyses.

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 3: Executive Summary of Worst Performing Areas
analysisSteps.question: What is the overall narrative of underperformance, and what are the priority areas for immediate intervention?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Synthesize the findings from Analysis 1.1.1 and Analysis 1.1.2 into a concise executive summary. Clearly state the top 3 worst performing RevOps Hierarchy units with their respective M0 to M1 drops. For each hierarchy, highlight the single worst performing campaign and its drop value. Provide a narrative explaining potential reasons for underperformance (e.g., campaign targeting issues, market saturation, poor campaign execution). Conclude with 3-5 actionable recommendations such as: pausing or re-evaluating the worst campaigns, reallocating budget from underperforming hierarchies, conducting a root cause analysis on conversion barriers, or improving lead qualification processes. Ensure the summary is business-friendly and suitable for presentation to senior leadership.
